cohort: Women with medium or high risk for preeclampsia (PE) who underwent placental growth factor (PlGF)-based testing between December 20, 2021 and December 31, 2022.
finding: A predictive nomogram for preeclampsia, constructed based on independent risk factors including BMI, MAP, sFlt-1/PlGF ratio, and various medical and pregnancy histories, demonstrated desirable efficacy with AUROCs of 0.883 (95% CI 0.838-0.928) in the training set and 0.862 (95% CI 0.774-0.951) in the validation set.
gest_age: Gestational age at the time of PlGF-based testing for the PE group was 20.0 weeks (range 16.1-26.1 weeks) and for the non-PE group was 22.2 weeks (range 16.2-27.3 weeks).
